data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'faiz', meaning 'success' or 'victory'. The name Faiza is given to a girl who is expected to succeed in her endeavors and carry on her family's legacy. The name Faiza carries the meaning “Successor, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faiza usually hope their child will grow to embody successor, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
